description: 16:9 desktop hero shots for the README — one per profile, full-page screenshots.

notes.purpose: Public README hero gallery. Run with --local from any machine with this repo cloned.
notes.finances: capture.ps1 renders with the real date, which turns the 2026-06-20 example into months of overdue alerts and names the file finances_1920.png. Recapture finances with Playwright instead: addInitScript(() => { window.dashboardToday = '2026-06-20' }), 1920x1080, dark, fullPage, saved as docs/screenshots/hero/1920/finances-1920.png.
